title: OpenCampus · UO Eugene
description: Explore the University of Oregon campus with a photo-informed Architectural Toon Realism visual pilot.
source_description: Oregon DOGAMI / NOAA Digital Coast. Historical survey: 2008-08-31. Nine source tiles cover the main campus and surrounding context.
about_summary: The Knight Library–EMU–Johnson Hall pilot adds three photo-informed landmarks, ten stylized historical buildings and one unidentified context envelope, illustrative lawns and paths, and 220 stylized trees over unchanged historical terrain. The rest of the campus remains a whitebox.
about_limitations: Pilot dimensions and facade details are approximate artistic interpretations of public UO photographs, not measured current reconstructions. Added vegetation, paving and furnishings are illustrative placements. Base terrain and roof candidates retain their 2008 provenance; Census roads retain estimated widths. The square extent is not a property boundary. Buildings have exterior-only collision; decorative stairs and furniture are not a navigation survey.

source_links.label: Visual pilot · photo references and model notes

project_description: Open Campus: UO develops this campus model and viewer. Its public upstream pipeline develops reusable reconstruction methods, automation and the browser template. Additional maps can build on the same template.
footer: Independent reconstruction project. No University of Oregon endorsement. Public development preview.
